threat_model.threat_source: AGI (after it is developed), to which 'humanity will gradually cede control of the Earth'
threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: No intention is stated for AGI; the harmful outcome described is human extinction: humanity cedes control of the Earth to AGI 'in a manner that leads to our extinction through any number of effects including pollution, resource depletion, armed conflict, or all three,' culminating in 'the death of the last surviving humans' and 'the death of humanity'
threat_model.access: Control of the Earth, gradually ceded by humanity to AGI ('humanity will gradually cede control of the Earth to AGI')
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: The ceding of control occurs only 'after it's developed'; the process is gradual ('gradually cede control'; 'a gradual automation of industries'); most of the probability lies 'between 2030 and 2040,' with 'the death of the last surviving humans occurring sometime between 2040 and 2050'; the automated industries must be 'together sufficient to fully sustain a non-human economy'
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: Humanity ('our extinction'; 'the death of the last surviving humans'; 'the death of humanity') and humanity's control of the Earth (ceded to AGI)

evidence.threat_source: humanity will gradually cede control of the Earth to AGI after it's developed
